reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday matcher and routes isWeekendOrHoliday and all three inline holiday checks in schedules/app.ts through it, though app.ts re-composes d.isWeekend || isHoliday instead of exporting the existing isWeekendOrHoliday.

duplication.why: Holiday matching (full date or MM-DD) is now in one function; the weekend-or-holiday composition is still spelled out three times (isWeekendOrHoliday plus two sites in app.ts) and getDatesInRange keeps a redundant second holiday branch.

placement.why: isHoliday lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isWeekendOrHoliday.

scope.why: Focused, with some unrelated reformatting of existing test calls, imports and lines.

maintainability.why: Future holiday-format changes touch a single function; the duplicated weekend-or-holiday composition and leftover redundant branch are small blemishes.
